content: The experimental results are depicted in Figure 3 . As the chart shows, our model outperforms all the other options we have considered. In detail, the left part of the chart shows that the leaf-LSTM is the most effective option compared to its competitors. Note that the sequential leaf-LSTM is somewhat superior or competitive than the bidirectional leaf-LSTM when both have a comparable number of parameters. We conjecture this may because a backward LSTM does not add additional useful knowledge when the structure of a sentence is already known. In conclusion, we use the uni-directional LSTM as a leaf module because of its simplicity and remarkable performance.
